stemMd: A technician must inspect every pair among five instruments exactly once. How many pair inspections are required?
explanationMd: Each of five instruments can pair with four others, producing 20 ordered pairs. Divide by two because inspecting X with Y is the same as Y with X, giving 10.

distractorRationale.a: This counts instruments rather than pairs.
distractorRationale.e: This includes self-pairs and order duplicates.
distractorRationale.d: This counts each unordered pair twice.
